description: React component implementing the Direct Trajectory panel for role path visualization, gap analysis, and roadmap in a career development app.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Converts unknown input to trimmed string, handling nullish values.

methods.name: safeStringArray
methods.description: Ensures input is an array of non-empty trimmed strings.

methods.name: roleIdFromRole
methods.description: Extracts a role ID string from various possible role object structures.

methods.name: roleTitleFromRole
methods.description: Extracts a role title string from various role object structures.

methods.name: uniqueByTitle
methods.description: Removes duplicate role options by case-insensitive title.

methods.name: horizonWeeks
methods.description: Maps a time horizon label to a number of weeks.

methods.name: horizonLabel
methods.description: Returns human-readable label for a given time horizon.

methods.name: intersectSet
methods.description: Finds intersection of two string arrays, case-insensitive.

methods.name: differenceSet
methods.description: Finds elements present in required set but missing in have set, case-insensitive.

methods.name: fetchRoleOptionsForCurrentRole
methods.description: Fetches role options autocomplete suggestions based on current role title.

methods.name: fetchTargetRoleDetailsById
methods.description: Fetches detailed role info using role ID via search API.

methods.name: extractPersonaSkills
methods.description: Aggregates and deduplicates skills from persona data.

methods.name: extractRequiredSkills
methods.description: Extracts required skills from role details.
